text:
Thanks for checking ahead! 🌿

If you wait until tonight (about 5 hours from now), the **2-hour** free change window will have closed. Your order will be in the packing queue, and it can't be changed online from "My Orders" at that point.

Here's what you can still do:

- **Contact support after the window closes.** We can try to intercept your order before it ships, but I can't guarantee it will work. If the order has already shipped, it can't be changed.
- **Act within the next 1 hour 40 minutes** if you can. That's the only time you're guaranteed the free online change option.

Also, I can't confirm from my information whether adding a new item to an existing order is possible through "My Orders", so if you don't see that option, just let me know and I'll pass it to our support team.

Is there anything else I can help with? Happy planting! 🪴
